name: DnBass
description: Tempo-synced drum & bass kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Half-time snare on 3 with syncopated kicks; X grows rolling hats, Y pushes break energy toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default ~174 BPM.

params.name: BREAK
params.detail: Break energy: ghost kicks/snares and fill push
